description: This file defines various constant values used throughout the QUIC protocol implementation, including time constants, packet size limits, flow control parameters, retransmission settings, and other protocol-specific constants.

methods.name: MaxRandomInitialPacketNumber
methods.description: Returns the maximum value for randomly initialised packet numbers.

methods.description: Returns the packet number of the first sending packet of a connection.
